capabilities: Highlight glossary terms in any inflected word form in Reading view and the editor
Convert highlighted terms into [[Title|word]] links per note, selection, or vault with preview
Collect new aliases from hand-written links, with collision warnings
Suggest glossary links while typing (optional autocomplete)
Show a glossary overview with term usage counts and candidate terms
extras: The catalog listing carries the notice 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.' Beta builds are available via BRAT; the README also points to sibling plugins Code Linker and Reference Linker.
intentEvidence: It was inspired by Virtual Linker, but it matches inflected forms instead of exact spellings only.
motivation: The author wanted a linker that matches inflected word forms, which Virtual Linker's exact-spelling matching does not do.
problem: Obsidian only links exact note titles, so plurals, cases and other inflected mentions of a term stay as unlinked plain text.

relations.evidence: It was inspired by Virtual Linker, but it matches inflected forms instead of exact spellings only.
Heading Linker — the file-based sibling of this plugin: each heading inside a chosen file is a term
How a highlight looks is exposed to the Style Settings plugin under a Glossary Linker section
Dataview — query the glossary from DataviewJS through the public API

summary: Glossary auto-linker that highlights term mentions in any inflected word form and converts them to wiki links on demand, using per-language stemmers.
